notes: The four paddles and the two SAX keys, without touching Profile, run on the App path and then on Driver LIVE back to back. Each press must bring exactly one pad item, whichever button the controller's current profile gives (the result names it), and the same item on both paths: compare the two reports with scripts/tools/dev-run-compare.py, which names the item per key and fails on a difference. The factory D-pad and A / B echoes are not assumed any more, so a changed profile does not fail a step; a key for which the controller sends no button reads "cannot judge". If the two passes differ, the driver's translation is at fault, not the profile. Do not press Profile.

steps.detail: Paddle outer left is on the back. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad shows a paddle as the button the controller's own profile sends for it.
steps.title: Press Paddle outer left twice

steps.detail: Paddle inner left is on the back. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad shows a paddle as the button the controller's own profile sends for it.
steps.title: Press Paddle inner left twice

steps.detail: Paddle inner right is on the back. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad shows a paddle as the button the controller's own profile sends for it.
steps.title: Press Paddle inner right twice

steps.detail: Paddle outer right is on the back. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad shows a paddle as the button the controller's own profile sends for it.
steps.title: Press Paddle outer right twice

steps.detail: SAX left is on the left side. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad shows this one as the button the controller's own profile sends for it.
steps.title: Press SAX left twice

steps.detail: SAX right is on the right side. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad shows this one as the button the controller's own profile sends for it.
steps.title: Press SAX right twice

title: Paddles and SAX echo (App, then Driver)
